servicesHome.title: Exams and diagnostics at the clinic
servicesHome.description: Prevention, ultrasound, colposcopy, and consultations — with time to talk and a clear explanation of findings.

serviceBlurbs.profilaktichen-ginekologichen-pregled: Regular preventive exams help detect changes early — often before symptoms appear. The visit includes an assessment based on your age and history.
serviceBlurbs.akushero-ginekologichni-pregledi: A visit for symptoms, follow-up after tests, or a second opinion. We start with your concerns and finish with a clear plan.
serviceBlurbs.ultrazvukovi-izsledvaniya: Ultrasound supports assessment of the uterus and ovaries. Findings are explained during the visit, including whether further steps are needed.
serviceBlurbs.kolposkopiya: A specialized exam of the cervix after an abnormal Pap smear or visible changes. The goal is a more precise assessment and a calm follow-up plan.
serviceBlurbs.histeroskopiya: Consultation and guidance when an inspection of the uterine cavity may be indicated. We discuss whether the procedure is appropriate and how to prepare.
serviceBlurbs.zhensko-zdrave: Time for questions about your cycle, symptoms, or test results. Together we decide whether an exam is needed and what comes next.

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: Book online via Superdoc or call the clinic at 0894 972 626.

faqs.question: Does the clinic work with NHIF?
faqs.answer: Yes, Dr. Raykova works with NHIF (Bulgarian public health insurance). Some tests may require co-payment.

faqs.question: Does Dr. Raykova provide pregnancy follow-up?
faqs.answer: No. Dr. Raykova does not provide pregnancy follow-up and does not examine children. The focus is gynecological prevention, diagnostics, and women's health consultations.

faqs.question: In which languages are visits available?
faqs.answer: Dr. Maria Raykova sees patients in Bulgarian, English, and Spanish.

faqs.question: Where is the clinic?
faqs.answer: Appointments are at Lyulin Med Medical Center — Dobrila 10 Branch, 10 Dobrila St., opposite VMA, Sofia.

privacy.title: Privacy and cookie policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how Dr. Maria Raykova’s website processes personal data and uses cookies. The site is informational and directs appointment booking to Superdoc.
privacy.controllerBody: The data controller for this website is Dr. Maria Raykova, clinic at Lyulin Med Medical Center — Dobrila 10 Branch, 10 Dobrila St., opposite VMA, Sofia. Contact: 0894 972 626.
privacy.scopeBody: This policy covers visits to this website. Appointment booking, registration, and communication via Superdoc are handled by Superdoc under their own terms and privacy policy.
dataItems: Technical visit data: IP address, device/browser type, pages viewed, and approximate visit time — as needed for site operation and security.
Cookie and local-storage data — according to your choice in the cookie banner.
If you call us, we process the information you voluntarily provide so we can respond.
purposesItems: Keeping the website working, secure, and correctly displayed.
Remembering language preference and cookie choice.
Improving content and experience if you accept optional cookies.
privacy.legalBody: We process data based on: legitimate interest in maintaining and securing the site; handling your request when you call; and consent — for optional cookies.
privacy.cookiesEssentialBody: Required for basic site functions — for example remembering your cookie and language choices. These do not require consent.
privacy.cookiesOptionalBody: May be used for statistics or improvements only after consent via the banner. You can accept essential cookies only.
privacy.thirdBody: The site may redirect to Superdoc for booking and to Google Maps for directions. Those services have their own policies. We do not control how they process data after you leave this site.
privacy.retentionBody: Technical and cookie data are kept only as long as needed for the stated purposes, or until you withdraw consent / clear your browser. Phone enquiries are not systematically archived via the website.
privacy.rightsIntro: Under the GDPR you have the right to:
rightsItems: erasure (“right to be forgotten”), where applicable;
withdraw consent for optional cookies at any time.
privacy.rightsContact: To exercise your rights, call 0894 972 626. You may also lodge a complaint with the Bulgarian Commission for Personal Data Protection (CPDP).
privacy.securityBody: We apply reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect the site. No online system is completely secure.
privacy.changesBody: We may update this policy when needed. The current version is always published on this page.
